title.narrative: Bangladesh Agroecology Platform Seed and Seed Sovereignty Group

description.narrative:
The Seed and Seed Sovereignty Group is one of 3 subgroups of the Bangladesh Agroecology Platform (BAP). BAP was formed to bring together likeminded organisations, working on similar issues related to agroecology and the environment to advocate for change and to improve the lives of the poorest and most marginalised. The members are Ubinig (chair of this subgroup), Caritas Bangladesh, Bangladesh Association for Sustainable Development, Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association and Bangladesh Krishok Federation. The other two subgroups will work on (i) promotion of agroecology principles; and (ii) land & indigenous rights, farmers rights (women’s rights), biodiversity preservation.
The Seed subgroup has designed a a series of collective actions aimed advocating on issues relating to seed conservation, GMOs, the protection of traditional knowledge and farmers rights connected to seeds. These will include workshops, a rally, a press conference and the publication of a range of policy and awareness raising materials. Each organisation will also conduct individual actions and research in areas of particular interest connected to seeds. For example Ubinig will research rice varieties, conduct market monitoring of farmers seeds, and monitor issues around GM seeds for which companies are currently seeking approval from the Bangladeshi Government. Ubinig is the lead partner for this two year project and will take responsibility for receiving the funds and coordinating disbursement as agreed to the other four partners for their individual actions.
